dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000pexc](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000pexc) Magnitude 5.6 earthquake at 103.467 depth occurred on Feb 20 2025 60km N of Niuatoputapu. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -15.4151 longitude -173.8496. It impacted 29 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
